title: Airport name patterns
statementMd:
List airports whose city name has exactly 5 letters (`_____`).

Expected columns: `code`, `city`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT code, city FROM airports WHERE city LIKE '_____';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
